summary: Iteration 332 — Jessi Live Voice feature (backend + frontend) tested end-to-end. Backend regression (test_live_voice.py + test_lab_api.py) 11/11 passed. New API surface tests (test_live_voice_api_iter332.py) 12/12 passed covering /api/live-voice/config, /admin/config GET+PUT (incl. invalid voice 400 + qa-manager 403), /admin/preview, /session (503 for forest with OPENAI_API_KEY reason, 403 lab+assistant for rep, 400 empty sdp), and /api/lab/features containing jessi_live_voice with status 'lab' and needs mentioning OPENAI_API_KEY. Frontend verified as forest on preview: Home shows gold Talk to Jessi row with LIVE pill and 'Needs OPENAI_API_KEY...' subtext (data-testid talk-to-jessi-btn), tap navigates to /admin/voice-lab. Voice Lab renders all expected data-testids: header, needs-key banner, intro, 13 voice tiles (Gleam default), 4 level rows with pills, gold hints (level-energy-hint changed from 'upbeat and energetic' to 'high-energy and lively' on tap of level-energy-5), notes, voice-preview updated (contained 'high-energy and lively' and 'quick-moving, no dead air'), greeting, cap pills, idle pills, Audition button disabled (aria-disabled=true), Save button became 'Save for everyone', save persisted after reload, and voice-saved-at showed 'Saved 9/17/2026, 4:31:00 PM by forest@imosapp.com'. Defaults restored (Gleam, energy 4, pacing 4, playful 3, brevity 4, cap 15, idle 25) via PUT /admin/config. Recent Conversations block renders with stats tiles voice-stat-today/week/month and empty state ('No conversations yet'). Test Lab /admin/test-lab shows lab-feature-jessi_live_voice with 'IN THE LAB' status, lab-more-jessi_live_voice expands to reveal voice-lab-card containing voice-lab-open and voice-lab-talk (disabled, 'Waiting for OPENAI_API_KEY on the server'). Rep (activation-tester) Home correctly does NOT render the Talk to Jessi button. All observed behaviour matches the intended 'needs key' states — feature is a PASS.
